title: Shaama Dhal Gaiyan Nana
body:
Rab Janay, Ki Hoya Wada Kar Ke, Mureya Na Amri Jaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheti Aaja Akbar, Mai Vekhdiyan Raah Tere
Tere Aaon Ton Hy Pehlaan , Saaah Muk Na Jawan Mere
Beemar Nu, Haye Beemar Nu
Veeraan Is Dard Vichore Ne, Hy Jyundeya Maar Mukaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai Bareya Chaawan Nal, Tere Sehra Banaya Akbar
Shagun Manondi Tere, Oh Waqat Na Aya Akbar
Tere Wya De, Haye Tere Wya De
Dil Wich Reh Gaye Chaa Veerun, Sughra Ne Wain Ay Paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Chor Ke Tur Gaye Menu, Gal Laa Ke Waari Waari
Ayho Tak Ke Wadh Gayi Ay, Sughra Di Hor Beemari
Menu Kalleya, Haye Menu Kalleya
Chor Ke Tur Gaye Ne Veerun, Ujri Da Jee Ghabraya
<<DIVIDER>>
Lokon Seenay Barchi, Khaa Akbar Kitta Wain Ay
Madad Ko Poncho Meri, Baba Mazloom Hussain Ay
Syed Ne, Haye Syed Ne
Puttar Jawaan De Lashay Nu, Kinjh Maundeya Te Hai Chaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam De Qaidi Basharat, Jadon Ghar Nu Mur Ke Aaya
Puchdi Ro Ro Sughra, Kyun Mere Veer Nai Aaaye
Zainab Ne, Haye Zainab Ne
Allah Janay Kevain Sughra Nu, Veeran Da Haal Sunaya
